test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Kartik starts from Point A and drives 42 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 25 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 20 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 30 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All tums are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given:

Kartik starts from Point A and drives 42 km towards South.

He then takes a left turn, drives 25 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 20 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 30 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6354490c0601f49a6ffc2d7ae7a57f6c03bbf18cf5fcbcd5a2015526be4c2ae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41cd0f1456a7f2993e9ea2e0941eb12fce3b1d438d9c9f20dd21a4c9e6ac5da7.png] 

Thus, Kartik should drive (25 km - 20 km) 5 km in the west direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
